description: Work out how far to draw on an insulin syringe for a given peptide dose: takes the vial amount, the bacteriostatic water added and the dose wanted, and returns the syringe units, the volume in mL, the resulting concentration and how many doses the vial holds. USE THIS instead of doing the arithmetic yourself - it is the same calculation peptul.com/calculator runs, and it flags the mg-versus-mcg mix-ups that are a 1000x error. It converts a dose the user already has and never suggests a dose.

syringeUnits.description: Syringe size in units (30/50/100/300 for U100), default 100

vialAmount.description: Amount of peptide in the vial, e.g. 10

name: calculate_reconstitution
title: Calculate a reconstitution
